text:
maya: Quick kickoff for bench launch visuals + SDR playbook. Need a compact deliverable set: 3 hero social cards, 6 micro-tiles for sales, a single-page SDR playbook (visual + text), and a simplified routing diagram for the outreach flow.
liam: got it. i'll sketch comps tonight. do we want photographic hero images or the abstract gradient approach?
zoe: prefer gradients for consistency with recent campaign, but we need one hero variant with product UI screenshot. i'll drop the screenshot in the figma file.
pete: on the playbook, keep language short: pain -> impact -> CTA. Also include a short script for SDRs (25-40 words) for cold outreach.
maya: sizes: hero 1200x628, micro 800x800 (square tiles for sales sheets), routing diagram 1400x800, playbook 1-page letter (US) + PDF. deliverables due: first comps 2026-04-01, final by 2026-04-06.
brand-bot: Brand palette v2 locked. Reminder: logo safe zone 24px, use approved type scale. Contrast check required for buttons (AA).
liam: i'll produce three layout options (A/B/C) per hero and two layout options per micro-tile. i'll include export-ready PNGs and SVGs. will annotate copy length limits in Figma.
zoe: i'll provide two headline tones: technical and outcomes. also localize main headlines to FR/DE (short) — translations will come by 2026-04-03.
pete: request: add a slide-sized PNG (1920x1080) of the routing diagram for webinar deck. also need a plain-text version of the flow for sequence editors.
maya: noted. please include alt text for all assets and simple usage notes (where to use hero vs micro tile). liam, please record a 60-90s loom when final to show SDRs how to pick CTAs per persona.
liam: will do — ETA first draft 2026-04-01 afternoon. planning to attach the figma link once frames are up.
brand-bot: Starter frames created -> https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/bench-launch-kit (marketing-edit). Auto checklist:
```
Asset,Format,Sizes,Variants,Due
hero-social-card,PNG/SVG,1200x628,EN/FR/DE + UI shot,2026-04-06
micro-tile,PNG/SVG,800x800,EN/FR,2026-04-06
routing-diagram,PNG/SVG,1400x800,EN only + 1920x1080 export,2026-04-03
sdr-playbook,PDF/PNG,US Letter,EN/FR,2026-04-06
plain-text-flow,TXT,na,EN only,2026-04-03
loom-guide,MP4,60-90s,EN,2026-04-06
```
zoe: adding CTAs for A/B test: "Cut inference spend", "Ship LLM features faster", "Inference you can predict" — i'll rank by persona in the doc.
pete: also include an email-friendly 600x200 banner for outreach footers.
liam: ok adding that. will follow brand spacing & lockup rules. also will mark frames as "ready for export" in figma when done.
maya: thanks. high priority for webinar week. post updates in this thread and upload final zip to /marketing/assets/bench-launch-2026. legal & brand will do a quick QA on 4/06.
